tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dang sa skya pa'i chos skyong gzhan rnams la lhan cig tu mchod gtor 'bul tshul gyi yi ge bzhugs// 'dir dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud/ phur srung sogs la gtor bsngo dang thugs dam bskang ba'i phyag len gyi bsgrigs rim ngo mtshar can shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas deng sang gi bar du yang ma nyams par dar rgyas su 'dug pa 'di rnams dang lhan cig tu dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la gtor bsngo dang thugs dam bskang bar 'dod na/ bdag bskyed gang rigs kyi rjes su kyai rdor gtor bsngo nas bzung gur mgon lcam dral la gtor ma phul nas 'phrin bcol grub pa yan dkyus bzhin byas la/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar rlung nag ces pa nas/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo bskyed bstim gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol grub pa yan gtor chog bzhin byas la/ de nas zhal bzhi pa nas bzung gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar dang / de rjes mkhon bcug sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas yi ge brgya pa dang / de wa pi tsu nas brtsams lcam dral gnyis kyi sngags nam rdzogs grangs ji ltar rigs pa skabs thob kyi dmigs pa dang bcas bzlas tshar ba dang / dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i sngags dmigs pa dang bcas gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs rjes zhal bzhi pa dang phur srung gi sngags kyi bar dang / de nas 'phrin bcol/ bshag pa/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs sogs nas bzung ste/ gur lcam dral gyi bskang gso rgyas bsdus skabs su gang bab grub rjes/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i spyan 'dren/ bskang ba rgyas bsdus bshag pa gnyis rnams brgya tshar sogs gang dgos byas la/ de rjes nged rang gis brtsams pa'i dmag zor rgyal mo'i bstod gsar dbyangs gang 'os dang bcas grub mtshams/ zhal bzhi pa/ las mkhan pu tra lcam sring / dkar bdud sogs kyi bskang gso rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang /

spyi bskang sku dang gsung thugs ma sogs dkyus bzhin byas la/ de nas 'phrin bcol mgon po'i bskang gso gang byas kyi 'phrin bcol/ de'i mjug tu dmag zor rgyal mo'i bskang gso 'phrin bcol rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang / de bzhin du mgon po'i bzlog pa'i rjes su bzlog pa bya'o/ /bstod pa ni gur lcam dral gyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs shig grub mtshams su/ bh+yoḥrak+mo sogs sngags dbyangs dang / de nas dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bskang dpe'i nang du 'byung ba ltar gyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang 'os dang / de nas zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ las mkhan/ dkar bdud/ phur srung rnams kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang 'os dkyus bzhin dang / lha yi tshogs rnams sogs dang / rdo rje'i glu/ smon lam bkra shis rnams grub mtshams tshogs 'khor yod na bdag bskyed gang byas kyi cho gas tshogs byin rlabs bya zhing / spyi bstab kyi skabs su gur mgon lcam dral/ zhal bzhi pa sogs kyi spyi bstab kyang dkyus ma'i rjes su dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i spyi bstab bya'o/ /de nas 'phrin 'di la dbyangs byas tshe 'phrin bcol dang bkra shis thun mong du 'gre ba yin/ bcol srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma dang / dpal mgon mahā kā la sogs kyi bkra shis grub rjes mjug chog dkyus bzhin bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i phyag len gyi rim pa 'di ni gsar du byas pa'i rtog bzo rig bcos ma yin gyi/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin te/ sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed gdams pa rin chen 'bar bar blta bar gyis shig dang / log rtog gi gti mug sel bar 'gyur te/ yi ge 'di'i nang bzhin gyi phyag len ma 'phyugs pa'i sgo nas dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la rgyun dang dus kyi mchod gtor 'bul ba la brtson par bgyis na lha mo 'di gzhan las 'phrin las myur bar grags pas/

gang bcol ba'i las rnams 'bad med du 'grub par nges so/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dang sa skya pa'i chos skyong gzhan rnams lhan cig tu mchod gtor 'bul ba'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi drung du dpal ldan lha mo 'di'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis rang gi 'dod don 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dpal ldan lha mo 'di la dus kyi gtor ma chag med du 'bul ba la bsams nas bris pa 'dis don gnyer can rnams la phan par gyur cig /ka l+yā na war+dhān+tu// ༈ //dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bstod bskul 'phrin las myur du 'grub pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bh+yoḥchos dbyings spros bral ngang las gdul bya'i ngor/ /me rlung dbus su 'jigs rung khro mo'i sku/ /'phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i dpal ldan ma/ /dmag zor rgyal mo bdag la brtse bas dgongs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig mnyes byed pa'i/ /mchod rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul bsam mi khyab/ /sa dang bar snang yongs su gang ba 'di/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /thog med dus nas rang sems 'khrul snang gi /rtog pas bslangs pas las ngan ci bsags dang / /skye ba 'dir yang bcas rang gis bsdus pa'i/ /nyes ltung dri mas phog pa mthol lo bshag /mthu ldan khyod kyis bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs/ /'jig rten khams kyi 'gro rnams bde ba dang / /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /byang chub bar du mgon dang sdong grogs mdzod/ /pha rol ngan pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi/ /byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad zor la sogs/ /mi dang mi min gnod pa ma lus pa/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog tu gsol/ /chos kun sgrib med gzigs pa dus gsum gyi/

/rgyal ba ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku/ /de phyir mkhyen brtse nus pa kun gyi gter/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /gang sku nam mkha'i mdangs ldan me 'od 'phro/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con thod pas brel/ /drag mo'i gzugs can 'jigs pa'i rgyan cha 'phyang / /bdud dpung zil gnon lha mo'i sku la bstod/ /ha ha bzhad sgras sa gzhi kun g.yo zhing / /hūm̐ phaṭ drag po'i sgra yis log 'dren 'dul/ /thos pa tsam gyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i gsung la bdag bstod do/ /gdod nas chos kun ye stong ye bral ba'i/ /brjod bral ngang las skad cig ma g.yos kyang / /bstan pa bsrung phyir drag gtum tshul ston pa'i/ /bde gsal mi rtog lha mo'i thugs la bstod/ /ma cig lha mo'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /mthu ldan las kyi pho nya drag shugs can/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong la rab brtson pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /de ltar mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas nas/ /dam la gnas pa'i dam can khyed rnams kyis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /yid la re ba'i don 'di 'bad med du/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /gtad do gnyer ro dmag zor re ma ti/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel myur ba'i las la bskul/ /bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi 'dod don 'ga' 'bad med du 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ dpal sa skya'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang du myur ba nyid du sbyar ba 'dis dge legs mchog tu gyur cig /bkra shis// ༈ ༄/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i drag bskul bsam don myur 'grub bzhugs/

bla ma dang dmag zor lha mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bh+yoḥ dmag zor rgyal mo stobs mo che/ /khyod ni mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /de phyir myur ba'i las la bskul/ /sngon tshe khyod la gang bcol ba'i/ /las rnams 'bad med myur 'grub pa'i/ /yid ches mos pas rgyun du mchod/ /do nub drag po'i las la bzhengs/ /da lta nyid du sa gzhi 'di/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i dmag gis khongs/ /sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzod/ /sha za'i gtso mo mthu ma chung / /bstan pa'i dgra bo ngan pa 'dis/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku la brdos/ /nyes med sems can chad pas bcad/ /las 'bras bden pa khyad du bsad/ /bdag gi rtag tu bstan bsam pa/ /dgra 'dis sna tshogs thabs kyis 'tshe/ /da ni bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /bstan dgra gdug pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /lo dang zla bar ma 'gyangs par/ /lus sems phrol la zhal du bzhes/ /da lta nyid du rtags phyungs shig /bskul lo rbad do mthu ma chung / /dgra 'di'i lha srung yul 'khor bcas/ /bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rgyas pa dang / /byang chub bar du sdong grogs mdzod/ /ces pa'i bskul tshig bsam don myur 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab gcig pu rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can sbas pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid dang / rdo rje 'chang mi'i gzugs can rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis rjes su bzung zhing / snying nas dad pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'khon sa skya pa dge slong rig sngags 'chang ba ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpal sa skyar myur bar sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
